title: Emirates ID renewal step 1
text_en: Open the official ICP Smart Services portal (or ICP app) and select the relevant service.

text_en: Review the retrieved application details and correct any errors.

title: Emirates ID renewal step 3
text_en: Supply the category-specific supporting documents if the government integration does not retrieve them.

title: Emirates ID renewal step 4

title: Emirates ID renewal step 5
text_en: Complete fingerprints and signature at an ICP centre if required, especially for applicants aged 15 or over.

text_en: Track delivery; standard cards are delivered by approved courier and urgent cards collected from the ICP centre.
text_ar: تابع استلام البطاقة؛ التوصيل العادي عبر الناقل المعتمد والعاجل من مركز الهيئة.

title: Federal Decree Law No. 45/2021 — UAE Personal Data Protection Law
text_en: Provides a national framework for personal-data confidentiality, lawful handling and data-subject rights. Design controls: Collect only non-identifying status and eligibility information in this prototype.; Do not request or store Emirates ID numbers, passport numbers, or document images.; Never place personal identifiers in audit logs.; Disclose that third-party LLM processing is optional and require informed user choice.
text_ar: ينظم حماية البيانات الشخصية والسرية وضوابط المعالجة وحقوق أصحاب البيانات. Provides a national framework for personal-data confidentiality, lawful handling and data-subject rights.

title: UAE National Strategy for AI 2031
text_en: Promotes AI adoption in government services to improve lives, and emphasizes skills, data, governance and infrastructure. Design controls: Promote accessible Arabic/English self-service.; Measure usefulness and include human oversight.
text_ar: تشجع الاستراتيجية تبني الذكاء الاصطناعي في الخدمات الحكومية وتحسين حياة الأفراد مع تطوير الحوكمة والبيانات والبنية التحتية. Promotes AI adoption in government services to improve lives, and emphasizes skills, data, governance and infrastructure.

title: UAE AI Adoption Guideline in Government Services
text_en: Public-sector AI adoption guidance emphasizes responsible implementation, public value, readiness and governance. Design controls: Show official references and uncertainty.; Human review for missing/contradictory evidence.
text_ar: إرشادات لتبنّي الذكاء الاصطناعي في الخدمات الحكومية بصورة مسؤولة مع مراعاة الحوكمة وجاهزية التنفيذ. Public-sector AI adoption guidance emphasizes responsible implementation, public value, readiness and governance.

title: UAE PASS access model
text_en: UAE PASS signs users in to participating service providers; applications are completed on the providers’ portals rather than from the UAE PASS app itself. Design controls: Link to ICP service portal and never impersonate UAE PASS login.
text_ar: تُستخدم الهوية الرقمية الإماراتية لتسجيل الدخول إلى مواقع الجهات المقدمة للخدمات، وليس لتقديم جميع المعاملات داخل تطبيق الهوية الرقمية نفسه. UAE PASS signs users in to participating service providers; applications are completed on the providers’ portals rather than from the UAE PASS app itself.

title: ITU AI Readiness Framework 2.0 (2026)
text_en: ITU framework groups readiness in data, digital infrastructure, digital skills, innovation ecosystem, and AI policy; its detailed framework also supports dimensions, indices and metrics. Design controls: Track data provenance, open-source availability, inclusion, governance and measured tests.
text_ar: يقيّم إطار الجاهزية للذكاء الاصطناعي البيانات والبنية الرقمية والمهارات والابتكار وسياسات الذكاء الاصطناعي. ITU framework groups readiness in data, digital infrastructure, digital skills, innovation ecosystem, and AI policy; its detailed framework also supports dimensions, indices and metrics.

title: ITU-T Y.3172 ML pipeline reference
text_en: ITU-T Y.3172 defines architectural requirements and components for ML pipelines and their management and orchestration in future networks. This prototype uses an analogous modular pipeline; it does not claim formal conformity. Design controls: Keep ingestion, retrieval, policy reasoning, serving and evaluation separable.
text_ar: يصف معيار ITU-T Y.3172 بنية خطوط تعلم الآلة وإدارتها وتنسيقها في الشبكات المستقبلية. يستخدم النموذج مضاهاة مفاهيمية دون ادعاء مطابقة معيارية رسمية. ITU-T Y.3172 defines architectural requirements and components for ML pipelines and their management and orchestration in future networks. This prototype uses an analogous modular pipeline; it does not claim formal conformity.
